subagents.purpose: Runs the full Bol.com bid optimization cycle: authenticates with Bol.com Advertiser API v11, pulls all campaigns/ad groups/keywords (paginated), fetches 7d (fallback 30d) performance per keyword, calculates ACOS, applies bid adjustment tiers, pushes bid changes, and logs results to Supabase. Skips if Q2/Q3 and last run was less than 10 days ago.

key_rules: TACOS is the primary safety net — minimum 10% contribution margin per product must be preserved after ad spend
Max TACOS = Pre-Ad Margin − 10% (dynamic per product × channel)
Max ACOS = Max TACOS / PPC Share (PPC Share = Ad Sales / Total Sales from get_tacos)
ALL percentage values stored as WHOLE NUMBERS — 17.5 means 17.5%, never 0.175
Bid adjustments capped at −40% to +20% per run; never adjust same keyword more than once per 7 days
Q2+Q3 (Apr–Sep): optimize every 10 days. Q4+Q1 (Oct–Mar): every 5 days
Bol.com API always v11 — both Accept and Content-Type headers required
Paginate all Bol.com list endpoints until page returns < 50 results
Keywords list: POST /campaign-management/keywords/list (NOT /keyword-management/) — only works on ENABLED campaigns
Keyword bid update payload MUST include state: ENABLED; bid as {amount: x, currency: EUR}
TACOS calculated from P&L actuals (pl_monthly view), never from ad revenue alone
IntentWise data: can calculate ACOS but NEVER TACOS — TACOS requires total revenue from Agent Central or P&L
Each product should have its own campaign for clean per-product optimization
Control absolute spend first — a keyword burning €500 at 40% ACOS is more dangerous than 80% ACOS at €5
